video_title: Full Denver Nuggets Postgame Media Availability vs. LAL 🎙

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan on the joy of playing with his family present
quotes.excerpt: every time I come back home after the family just come and still be playing after so long
quotes.quote: It's always just enjoyable to have the kids and every time I come back home after the family just come and still be playing after so long and just appreciating the game, it's always fun.
quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan on playing in front of his family: It is always enjoyable to have the kids there and still be playing after so long. It is always fun.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan explains his decision-making process on his post-up dunk
quotes.excerpt: I seen an opening baseline and I said I got to get on this other side
quotes.quote: I just seen an opening. I seen an opening baseline and I said I got to get on this other side of the rim and dunk it. So it was cool just to see all the guys' reaction.
quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan on his post-up dunk: I saw an opening baseline and I said I have to get on this other side of the rim and dunk it.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan on the team's growth and preseason experimentation
quotes.excerpt: we just been going out there trying things, going back looking at ways we could clean up
quotes.quote: We just been going out there trying things, going back looking at ways we could clean up things that we're trying and trying to just get better at it. Tonight was our last preseason game, just trying to put it all out there, play with effort, have something to go back and look at it, clean up on.
quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan on the preseason: We have been going out there trying things and looking at ways we can clean up our execution to get better.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan on the high basketball IQ of Jamal Murray and Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: how dynamic they are, how creative, smart, the IQ, they are champions
quotes.quote: Just everything with the be expected. How dynamic they are, how creative, smart, the IQ, they are champions. So going out there playing with them make everything easy.
quotes.social_post: DeMar DeRozan on playing with Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray: They are dynamic, creative, and smart. Going out there playing with them makes everything easy.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman praises Trevon's performance and rebounding ability
quotes.excerpt: he gave all the things we know he can do, the eight rebounds is good to see
quotes.quote: He was good. He gave all the things we know he can do, the eight rebounds is good to see. That's something we know he naturally can do every night if he's willing to compete. He ran the floor well, just has to clean things up. He's got to see the ball when he runs offensively.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Trevon: He gave us all the things we know he can do. Eight rebounds is good to see and that is something he can do every night if he is willing to compete.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on the focus and intensity shown by Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray
quotes.excerpt: I just saw tonight they were really focused and they wanted to play
quotes.quote: I just saw tonight they were really focused and they wanted to play. You work your way through this preseason stuff and this is what you want to see the last game. There was intensity to it, there was focus, execution on both ends, and those guys, they really flowed well together tonight.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the team's intensity: I saw tonight they were really focused and they wanted to play. There was intensity, focus, and execution on both ends.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman discusses the effectiveness of the second unit
quotes.excerpt: Cam allows us to have multiple options with DeRozan out there
quotes.quote: I thought they were good in the first half. Cam allows us to have multiple options with DeRozan out there. I was very impressed with the group in the fourth quarter. We wanted Tias and Marvin to get a long run because Marvin hasn't played, he's been hurt, and Tias needed to play more minutes. I thought those guys were really good.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the second unit: I was very impressed with the group in the fourth quarter. We wanted Tias and Marvin to get a long run to get their minutes up.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman addresses the flagrant foul call on the court
quotes.excerpt: I knew it was going to be a flagrant foul, I didn't realize it would be a flagrant two
quotes.quote: I knew it was going to be a flagrant foul, I didn't realize it would be a flagrant two just because he wasn't facing the other player. But they said that the hit to the face was deemed a flagrant two. If that's the case, then you might see a lot of flagrant twos.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the flagrant two call: I knew it was going to be a flagrant, but I did not realize it would be a two. If that is the case, then you might see a lot of flagrant twos.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on DeMar DeRozan's veteran leadership and fit
quotes.excerpt: he's been everything as advertised, you can isolate him, you can put him in situations
quotes.quote: He's been everything as advertised. You can isolate him, you can put him in situations where he backs them down and scores, what he's always done. But I just like his personality. He fits our guys, we're a veteran team, it's crazy to say this we're one of the older teams in the league, so he fits.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on DeMar DeRozan: He has been everything as advertised. I just like his personality. He fits our guys because we are a veteran team.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Nikola Jokic's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: he has to contain the ball, not let people turn the corner, he's very underrated in that sense
quotes.quote: He has to contain the ball, not let people turn the corner. We say this all the time, he's very underrated in that sense. He's got great hands. I thought the guys did a good job with that. We talked about that throughout the day, the high hands. I love Trev, he got in there and got the steal early.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on Nikola Jokic: He has to contain the ball and not let people turn the corner. He is very underrated in that sense and has great hands.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman identifies turnovers as the primary area for improvement
quotes.excerpt: today was the turnovers, but you look at the last two games the points off turnovers are way too high
quotes.quote: Today was the turnovers, but you look at the last two games the points off turnovers are way too high. That gets you beat, especially in OKC. But I think we'll rewatch the game tonight and there's so much to clean up with the different lineups, clean up execution stuff offensively.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on areas for improvement: The points off turnovers are way too high. That gets you beat. There is so much to clean up with the different lineups and execution.
